newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA TO SELL STAKE IN LEAD AND ZINC SMELTER.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA TO SELL STAKE IN LEAD AND ZINC SMELTER.

text.p: Bulgaria's newly elected cabinet gave a green light on Thursday to the sale of up to a 75 percent stake in the Kardzhali-based Lead and Zinc producer.
Privatisation Agency executive director Alexander Sabotinov told reporters there were four bidders so far.
The bidders are Switzerland's Khorus Services S.A. and Newco AG, London-based Banque Paribas and Germany's Triacom Industrie Beteiligungs GmbH, Sabotinov said.
Officials said the plant needed fresh funds to enlarge its production and for environmental improvements.
The assets of the mining and smelter complex are 900 million levs according to its last evaluation in 1992.

Bulgaria's newly elected government of the Union of Democratic Forces vowed to accelerate privatisation in the industrial sector in an attempt to revive the country's ailing economy and boost its currency reserves.
